Fist Lochan is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the Rivington in Act Three.
“
Please just go home - you're ruining a perfectly uneventful posting with this nonsense.
„
— Lochan, to the group of protesters

Involvement

Lochan together with  Fist Poole,  Fist Rowan,  Fist Madigan,  Fist Varone and  Fist Broadhorn, under command of  Manip Nestor, guards the goods donated to the benefit of refugees, put into storage inside the Requisitioned Barn.

Lochan can be found just across the front entrance to the barn, trying to placate a group of protesters:  Saer Grotpoll,  Ricks Garven, and  Mandii Harvestmoon, who call the Fist to not guard the refugees, but to forfend[1] the citizens of Baldur's Gate from the refugees.
